overlaps.detail: Both roadmaps assign the migration of units_sq_index_le and its abstract squaring-index input. EffectiveBounds Layer 1 states [O_F^×:(O_F^×)^2] <= 2^[F:Q]; Multiquadratic Layer 2 lists the same unit-square input, and its migration-source section explicitly calls the port shared with EffectiveBounds.
overlaps.proposal: Keep the number-field unit-square bound with EffectiveBounds and its generic group helper in shared algebra. Multiquadratic should consume that theorem, not migrate it again, while retaining its ambiguous-class formula and class-group elementary-two quotient. The degree exponent [F:Q] is not the number of ramified primes. No merger is needed.

overlaps.detail: GlobalNumberFields Layer 2 constructs the general narrow class group, its map to the ordinary group and the unit-sign kernel; Multiquadratic Layer 3 independently claims the narrow-class definition. The common carrier is the ray class group for all real places with trivial finite modulus.
overlaps.proposal: GlobalNumberFields owns the general carrier and narrow-to-ordinary map; Multiquadratic owns the quadratic specialization and genus-field/elementary-two-quotient calculations. Fix the real-place inconsistency before identifying the ordinary genus field with the full prime-discriminant compositum: for discriminant 12=(-4)(-3), that compositum contains i and complexifies the real places of Q(sqrt(3)). The full compositum belongs to the finite-place-unramified/narrow convention; the ordinary construction needs the real-place restriction. This packet does not edit the source roadmaps.
